The process

A clear path. A little magic.

From our first conversation to your finished website, here is how we work together.

Branding / first

I build websites. Branding comes first.

I don't offer branding services, so you'll need an existing brand identity and visual direction. If you need help with branding, I can introduce you to people who specialize in it.

Let's talk →

  1. 01

    Discovery call

    We talk about your goals, audience, current website and what the new site needs to do.

  2. 02

    Your content & assets

    You send your copy, logo, brand guidelines, images and other assets. A defined branding direction is needed before the homepage exploration begins.

  3. 03

    2 or 3 homepage drafts

    I prepare two or three homepage drafts to explore visual directions. We choose a main direction and can bring in elements from the other drafts or your references.

  4. 04

    Homepage refinement

    Up to 2 revision rounds

    We bring your feedback together to refine the selected homepage before moving into the rest of the website.

  5. 05

    Static pages

    Up to 2 revision rounds

    I build the agreed static pages using the approved direction. The two rounds cover the full set, not each page.

  6. 06

    CMS pages, when needed

    Up to 2 revision rounds

    I build the agreed CMS collections and templates. The two rounds cover the complete CMS set.

  7. 07

    Final checks & handover

    We review the finished website, confirm the agreed scope and prepare for launch. The Webflow project is transferred to your account.

Good to know

What is a revision round?

One consolidated set of feedback on the current stage. New pages, a new scope or a change of direction after approval are discussed separately, so the project stays clear for both of us.
